server_cli.help:
{binary} {version} - Global city and US ZIP code lookup service

Usage:
  {binary} [flags]

Information:
  -h, --help                             Show help
  -v, --version                          Show version
      --status                           Show server status and health

Shell Integration:
      --shell completions [SHELL]        Print shell completions
      --shell init [SHELL]               Print shell init command
      --shell --help                     Show shell help

Server Configuration:
      --mode {production|development|debug}  Application mode
      --config DIR                       Config directory
      --data DIR                         Data directory
      --cache DIR                        Cache directory
      --log DIR                          Log directory
      --backup DIR                       Backup directory
      --pid FILE                         PID file path
      --address ADDR                     Listen address (default: [::])
      --port PORT                        Listen port (default: random 64000-64999, 80 in container)
      --i2p[=BOOL]                       Enable or disable the optional I2P eepsite
      --baseurl PATH                     URL path prefix (default: /)
      --daemon                           Run as daemon
      --debug                            Enable debug logging
      --color {auto|yes|no}              Color output (default: auto)
      --lang CODE                        Language for output (default: auto)

Service Management:
      --service CMD                      Service management (run --service --help for details)
      --maintenance CMD                  Maintenance operations (run --maintenance --help for details)
      --update [CMD]                     Check or install updates (run --update --help for details)

Run '{binary} <flag> --help' (for example '{binary} --service --help') for command details.
server_cli.maintenance_help:
Maintenance commands:
  --maintenance backup [file]
  --maintenance restore <file>
  --maintenance update [check|yes|branch {stable|beta|devel}]
  --maintenance mode
  --maintenance setup
  --maintenance pgp {generate|rotate|publish|export|import|delete}
  --maintenance token {list|revoke <prefix> [--yes]}
  --maintenance secret rotate <name>
  --maintenance data {export|delete} --owner <prefix>
  --maintenance compliance report

PGP key export, import, secret rotation, and token revocation require operator authorization and typed confirmation.
Token revocation and data deletion accept --yes to skip the typed confirmation in scripts.

about.title: About
about.lead: Public reference data for cities and United States ZIP codes.
about.description: Citylist provides read-only geographic reference data through a web interface and public APIs.
about.data: City records are based on GeoNames. United States ZIP code data is bundled with the application. Source and license details are published in the project documentation.
about.interfaces: Search the website, use the REST or GraphQL API, or connect with the companion command-line client and read-only MCP tools.
about.attribution_geonames: Global city and United States postal-code data from GeoNames, available under CC BY 4.0. The bundled records are used for read-only lookup.
about.feature_search: Open /search and enter a city name; add a two-letter country code to narrow the results.
about.feature_lookup: Request /api/v1/cities/{id} with a GeoNames ID or /api/v1/zipcodes/{zip} with a five-digit US ZIP code.
about.feature_browser: Use /coordinates to search by latitude and longitude, or enter a city or ZIP code in the browser search.
about.feature_apis: Send read-only requests to /api/v1, explore them in Swagger or GraphQL, or connect an assistant through /server/help/mcp.
about.feature_cli: Run citylist-cli with a city or ZIP lookup command to query the bundled datasets from a terminal.
about.feature_tokens: Open /server/preferences/tokens to create a linked token for an MCP client; revoke that token there when it is no longer needed.

help.lead: Find a lookup method or connect with an API client.
help.search: Search cities by name at /search, find nearby cities at /coordinates, or use the read-only API at {api}.
help.api: The API reference is available through Swagger and GraphQL. OpenAPI JSON is available at {api}/server/swagger.

help.faq_auth_question: Do public lookups need an API key?
help.faq_auth_answer: No. City and ZIP lookup endpoints are public and read-only. MCP integrations require an owner or linked Bearer token.
help.faq_write_question: Can I add or change city and ZIP records?
help.faq_write_answer: No. The embedded city and ZIP datasets are read-only.
help.faq_data_question: Where does the city data come from?
help.faq_data_answer: City records use GeoNames identifiers and data. ZIP code records cover the United States.
help.trouble_rate: The client exceeded the current per-address rate limit. Wait for the Retry-After interval before retrying.
help.trouble_invalid: Check that the query uses the documented parameter names and valid ranges, such as latitude from -90 to 90 and longitude from -180 to 180.
help.trouble_zip: The embedded ZIP dataset could not be loaded. Retry later; city lookup endpoints may remain available.
help.default_content:
### Citylist query notes

City-name searches accept 2–100 characters and an optional two-letter country code. Nearby-city queries accept latitude from -90 to 90, longitude from -180 to 180, a radius up to 20,000 km, and a result limit from 1 to 100. ZIP lookups use five-digit United States codes. City and ZIP records are embedded reference data; all lookup endpoints are read-only.

security.title: Security
security.lead: Report vulnerabilities privately and review the disclosure policy.
security.policy: Please report security vulnerabilities through GitHub private vulnerability reporting. Do not publish an unpatched vulnerability.
security.contact: The machine-readable disclosure instructions are available at /.well-known/security.txt.
security.report_intro: Report security vulnerabilities privately using the channels below, in order of preference.
security.encrypt_with_key: Encrypt reports with the project OpenPGP key.
security.thanks_lead: We thank the researchers who chose to be recognized for helping improve Citylist security.
security.other_reports_description: For terms violations, DMCA notices, and privacy requests, use the contact form.
security.policy_lead: This policy describes the scope of authorized security research and how to report findings.
security.policy_scope: The application served at {fqdn}, including its API and any other configured public hosts (including published Tor and I2P addresses), is in scope.
security.policy_out_of_scope: Denial of service and volumetric testing, social engineering, physical attacks, findings in third-party services without an exploitable path here, automated scanner output without demonstrated impact, and missing best-practice headers on non-sensitive pages are out of scope.
security.policy_disclosure: Please report privately through /server/security and allow 90 days from the report to publish. The window ends early once a fix is released and may be extended by agreement.
security.policy_safe_harbor: Good-faith research that follows this policy, avoids privacy violations and service disruption, accesses only what is needed to show the issue, and stops when it has done so is authorized. No legal action will be taken for such research.
security.thanks_empty: No acknowledgments have been published yet.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: How Citylist handles browser preferences, requests, and operational data.
privacy.gpc_notice: Your browser sent Global Privacy Control (GPC). This request is treated as an opt-out of data sale or sharing and behavioral analytics; preference and analytics cookies are disabled.
privacy.dnt_notice: Your browser sent Do Not Track (DNT). Preference and analytics cookies and behavioral analytics are disabled for this request. This signal does not change your data sale or sharing preference.
privacy.data: Citylist provides public geographic reference data and does not provide user accounts or store personal profiles. Search values are processed to answer each request.
privacy.cookies: The site uses a CSRF cookie for form security and may store theme, language, and consent preferences in your browser.
privacy.contact: For privacy questions, see the contact information on /server/security.
privacy.stored_on_server: The service processes public city and ZIP reference records and request data on this server.
privacy.data_sold: Data may be shared with or sold to third parties as described below.
privacy.data_not_sold: The service does not sell personal data.
privacy.collection: We collect only information needed to provide and protect the service. With analytics consent, this can include pages visited, features used, browser and device information, and approximate country or region inferred from an IP address, never precise location. Technical information includes IP addresses for security and abuse prevention and token identifiers stored as hashes. City and ZIP records are public reference data. Contact submissions may include your name, email address, and message; security reports and contact details are encrypted for follow-up. We do not collect payment information unless the service explicitly requires it, precise location, or data from other websites or apps.
privacy.usage_not_sold: We use data to provide the service and answer lookups, improve performance and fix bugs, prevent abuse and protect the service, and communicate service updates or security alerts. Product news is sent only with consent. We never sell data or use it for targeted advertising, and we do not share it without explicit consent except when required by law.
privacy.usage_sold: We use data to provide the service and answer lookups, improve performance and fix bugs, prevent abuse and protect the service, and communicate service updates or security alerts. Product news is sent only with consent. Data may also be shared with or sold to third parties for the purposes described in the disclosures below. You can record a sale opt-out below and request deletion through the privacy contact; see Your Rights for details.
privacy.security: The service validates requests, applies rate limits, stores API tokens as SHA-256 hashes, and encrypts stored contact and security-report data. Use HTTPS/TLS to protect data in transit; direct HTTP connections are not encrypted. Operator actions are access-controlled and audited, and security updates are applied regularly. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

help.title: MCP server
help.overview_body: Citylist provides read-only public city and US ZIP lookups over remote Streamable HTTP. Every MCP request requires a valid Bearer token; the REST lookup API remains public.
help.endpoint_prompt: The canonical endpoint for this request:
help.authentication_body: Every request needs an Authorization Bearer token. Issue a primary token from {issue_endpoint}, then create a separate linked token for each MCP client at {token_page}. Linked tokens can be revoked independently. Never put the operator token in an MCP client.
help.connect_intro: Choose a client setup below. Use a linked Bearer token in the MCP_TOKEN environment variable.
help.protocol_headers: Requests also carry MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28, Mcp-Method, and the matching protocol version in _meta.
help.limits_body: POST only, no sessions. The HTTP API rate limit applies. Requests with an Origin header must match this origin or an explicitly configured origin. Supported protocol version: 2026-07-28.
help.http_400: Check the JSON-RPC body, protocol version, and matching method/name headers.
help.http_401: Send a valid owner or operator Bearer token. Cookies are ignored.
help.http_403: Use the server’s own origin or an explicitly allowed origin.
help.http_405: Use POST. GET and DELETE are not supported.
help.page_lead: Connect an AI client to the Citylist lookup tools over Streamable HTTP.
